title: sieve-daemon: Axum server with /health, /check, /filter
description:
Implement the full sieve-daemon binary: Axum on a Unix socket serving three endpoints.

What: crates/sieve-daemon/src/main.rs + filter.rs + config.rs

Request/response types (serde JSON):
  POST /filter  body: { script_b64: String, message_b64: String, envelope_from: String, envelope_to: String }
                resp: { actions: [ {type: "Keep"} | {type: "FileInto", folder: String} | {type: "Discard"} | {type: "Reject", reason: String} ] }
  POST /check   body: { script_b64: String }
                resp: 200 {} | 422 { error: String }
  GET  /health  resp: 200 {}

Algorithm:
1. config.rs: read socket_path from env var SIEVE_DAEMON_SOCKET (fallback /run/usenet-ipfs/sieve.sock) or parse a minimal toml config if --config flag given.
2. filter.rs: CompiledScriptCache = Arc<Mutex<HashMap<[u8;32], Arc<CompiledScript>>>> keyed on sha256(script_bytes).
3. handle_filter(): base64-decode script + message; check cache by sha256 key; if miss compile and insert; call usenet_ipfs_sieve::evaluate(); map Vec<SieveAction> to JSON actions.
4. handle_check(): base64-decode script; call usenet_ipfs_sieve::compile(); return 200 or 422+error.
5. main.rs: bind tokio::net::UnixListener to socket_path (remove stale socket file if exists); axum::serve with Router.
6. SIGTERM handler: tokio::signal::unix to accept SIGTERM, call server shutdown.

Defensive rules:
- Validate base64 decode before any sieve call; return 400 on bad input.
- Catch compile errors: return 422 not 500.
- Never log script content or message body (may contain secrets/PII).
- Socket file permissions: 0600 after bind (chmod via std::fs).
